setupInstructions: Deploy render.yaml with AIVEN_DATABASE_URL configured in Render environment secrets (or run a Named Cloudflare Tunnel against your local Mac relay), verify restart persistence with `dart run tool/verify_deployment.dart --phase=before-restart https://<your-render-service>.onrender.com` and `--phase=after-restart --save https://<your-render-service>.onrender.com`, or save the verified HTTPS URL in WATSafe Settings -> Phone companion address & migration.
